buckets.label: Core
buckets.description: aida-core, proto, legacy requirements-core/requirements-manager monolith, aida-crate

buckets.label: Web UI
buckets.description: aida-web-react, legacy aida-web, shared TypeScript types

buckets.label: Tests & automation
buckets.description: tests, fixtures, benchmarks, scripts, CI workflows, Makefile

buckets.label: Documentation
buckets.description: docs/, prose files (.md/.txt/.docx...), root HTML reports, AIDA discipline docs

buckets.label: Packaging & integration
buckets.description: templates, agent integrations (.claude/.codex/...), plugins, Docker, root manifests and dotfiles

buckets.label: Generated, vendored & data artifacts
buckets.description: lockfiles, generated/vendored/dist dirs, requirement-store data, databases, binaries

rules.match: lockfiles; any path segment generated/vendor/vendored/node_modules/dist/target; aida-store/, .aida-store/, data/; requirements*.yaml, default_requirements.yaml, sample_project.yaml; minified/map/db/wasm/log/font/image files; this tool's own generated exports under docs/analytics/code-growth/
any tests/test/__tests__/benches/*fixtures/ directory; root bench/, scripts/, ci/, .github/; .gitlab-ci.yml, Makefile
aida-core/templates/, templates/, .claude/, .claude-plugin/, .codex/, .antigravity/, .gemini/, .aida/, plugins/, docker/, .cargo/ (before generic prose rule, so skill/template .md stay integration)
root manifests and dotfiles: Cargo.toml, pnpm-workspace.yaml, package.json, Dockerfile*, .dockerignore, .env.example, .gitignore, .gitattributes, .mcp.json
crate/app directory prefixes (see bucket descriptions): core, cli, server, tui, desktop_gui, web_ui, developer_tooling
